name: Coding Interview Pattern Taxonomy
description: All coding interview patterns organised by tier, category, and specific technique. From docs/notes/02-pattern-taxonomy/.

arrays-and-hashing.name: Arrays & Hashing
arrays-and-hashing.description: Tier 1: Hash-based lookups, frequency counting, prefix sums

p01-hash-map-lookup.name: #1 Hash Map Lookup
p01-hash-map-lookup.description: Use a dict for O(1) lookup. Classic: Two Sum.

p02-two-pass-hash.name: #2 Two-Pass Hash
p02-two-pass-hash.description: First pass builds the map, second pass queries it.

p03-frequency-counting.name: #3 Frequency Counting
p03-frequency-counting.description: Count occurrences with a dict or Counter.

p04-group-by-key.name: #4 Group By Key
p04-group-by-key.description: Group items by a computed key. Classic: Group Anagrams.

p05-set-deduplication.name: #5 Set for Deduplication
p05-set-deduplication.description: Use a set to track seen elements or eliminate duplicates.

p06-prefix-sum.name: #6 Prefix Sum
p06-prefix-sum.description: Precompute cumulative sums for O(1) range queries.

p07-difference-array.name: #7 Difference Array
p07-difference-array.description: Inverse of prefix sum for range update operations.

two-pointers.name: Two Pointers
two-pointers.description: Tier 1: Pointer techniques on sorted or linear data

p10-converging-pointers.name: #10 Converging Pointers
p10-converging-pointers.description: Left and right pointers moving inward. Classic: Two Sum II.

p11-same-direction.name: #11 Same Direction
p11-same-direction.description: Both pointers move forward at different speeds.

p14-slow-fast-floyds.name: #14 Slow/Fast (Floyd's)
p14-slow-fast-floyds.description: Cycle detection with slow and fast pointers.

p16-merge-two-sorted.name: #16 Merge Two Sorted
p16-merge-two-sorted.description: Merge two sorted arrays/lists with two pointers.

strings-and-parsing.name: Strings & Parsing
strings-and-parsing.description: Tier 1: Window techniques and string matching

p09-sliding-window-variable.name: #9 Sliding Window (Variable)
p09-sliding-window-variable.description: Expand/shrink window to meet a condition.

p13-rolling-hash.name: #13 Rolling Hash
p13-rolling-hash.description: Rabin-Karp style hash for string matching.

stacks-and-queues.name: Stacks & Queues
stacks-and-queues.description: Tier 2: LIFO/FIFO structures for matching, ordering, evaluation

p17-stack-matching.name: #17 Stack for Matching
p17-stack-matching.description: Match opening/closing pairs. Classic: Valid Parentheses.

p18-monotonic-stack.name: #18 Monotonic Stack
p18-monotonic-stack.description: Stack maintaining increasing/decreasing order for next-greater problems.

p19-monotonic-queue.name: #19 Monotonic Queue
p19-monotonic-queue.description: Deque maintaining order for sliding window max/min.

p20-expression-eval.name: #20 Expression Eval
p20-expression-eval.description: Evaluate arithmetic expressions using operator/operand stacks.

p22-search-on-answer.name: #22 Search on Answer
p22-search-on-answer.description: Binary search the answer space with a feasibility check.

p23-bisect-left-right.name: #23 Bisect Left/Right
p23-bisect-left-right.description: Find insertion point or boundary in sorted data.

p24-dfs-traversal.name: #24 DFS Traversal
p24-dfs-traversal.description: Pre/in/post-order tree traversal via recursion or stack.

p25-bfs-level-order.name: #25 BFS Level-Order
p25-bfs-level-order.description: Process tree level by level using a queue.

p26-bst-property.name: #26 BST Property
p26-bst-property.description: Exploit in-order sorted property of BSTs.

p27-tree-path-subtree-dp.name: #27 Tree Path / Subtree DP
p27-tree-path-subtree-dp.description: Compute path sums or subtree properties via post-order DFS.

graphs.name: Graphs
graphs.description: Tier 2: Graph representation, traversal, shortest paths

p29-graph-bfs.name: #29 Graph BFS
p29-graph-bfs.description: Breadth-first search for shortest paths in unweighted graphs.

p30-graph-dfs.name: #30 Graph DFS
p30-graph-dfs.description: Depth-first search for connectivity, cycle detection.

p31-topological-sort.name: #31 Topological Sort
p31-topological-sort.description: Order DAG nodes by dependency. Kahn's or DFS-based.

p32-union-find.name: #32 Union-Find (DSU)
p32-union-find.description: Disjoint set union for connected components.

p33-dijkstras.name: #33 Dijkstra's
p33-dijkstras.description: Shortest path in weighted graphs with priority queue.

p34-dfs-bfs-grid.name: #34 DFS/BFS on Grid
p34-dfs-bfs-grid.description: Treat 2D grid as implicit graph. Flood fill, island counting.

heaps.name: Heaps
heaps.description: Tier 2: Priority queues, top-k, merge patterns

p35-top-k.name: #35 Top-K / K-Smallest
p35-top-k.description: Use a heap to maintain the K largest/smallest elements.

p36-merge-k-sorted.name: #36 Merge K Sorted
p36-merge-k-sorted.description: Merge K sorted lists using a min-heap.

p37-two-heap-median.name: #37 Two-Heap (Median)
p37-two-heap-median.description: Track running median with a max-heap and min-heap.

p39-tabulation.name: #39 Tabulation
p39-tabulation.description: Bottom-up DP: fill a table iteratively.

p40-1d-dp.name: #40 1D DP
p40-1d-dp.description: DP on a single sequence. Climbing stairs, house robber.

p41-2d-dp.name: #41 2D DP
p41-2d-dp.description: DP on two dimensions. Edit distance, LCS.

p43-interval-dp.name: #43 Interval DP
p43-interval-dp.description: DP over intervals/ranges. Matrix chain, burst balloons.

greedy.name: Greedy
greedy.description: Tier 3: Locally optimal choices leading to global optimum

p44-greedy-choice.name: #44 Greedy Choice
p44-greedy-choice.description: Make the locally best decision at each step.

p47-permutations-combos.name: #47 Permutations/Combos
p47-permutations-combos.description: Generate all permutations or combinations via backtracking.

p48-constraint-satisfaction.name: #48 Constraint Satisfaction
p48-constraint-satisfaction.description: Place items satisfying constraints. N-Queens, Sudoku.

p49-word-path-search.name: #49 Word/Path Search
p49-word-path-search.description: Search for words/paths in grids via DFS + backtracking.

p50-merge-sort-pattern.name: #50 Merge Sort Pattern
p50-merge-sort-pattern.description: Divide into halves, sort, merge. Count inversions.

p51-quick-select.name: #51 Quick Select
p51-quick-select.description: Find kth element via partition. O(n) average.

other.name: Other Techniques
other.description: Tier 3: Sorting variants, bit manipulation, advanced structures

p52-custom-comparator-sort.name: #52 Custom Comparator Sort
p52-custom-comparator-sort.description: Sort with a custom key/comparator function.

p53-bucket-counting-sort.name: #53 Bucket/Counting Sort
p53-bucket-counting-sort.description: O(n) sort when value range is bounded.

p54-xor-single-element.name: #54 XOR for Single Element
p54-xor-single-element.description: XOR all elements to find the unique one.

p56-bitwise-arithmetic.name: #56 Bitwise Arithmetic
p56-bitwise-arithmetic.description: Add, multiply, divide using only bit operations.

p57-trie.name: #57 Trie (Prefix Tree)
p57-trie.description: Tree for prefix-based string operations. Autocomplete, spell check.

p58-segment-tree-bit.name: #58 Segment Tree / BIT
p58-segment-tree-bit.description: Range query and point update in O(log n).
